### Create menu

With `createActions` the Create button opens a menu instead of acting at once: the + turns into ×, the page dims and
the actions fly out one after another (motion engine: global speed and reduced motion apply). It opens on the layer
stack, so inside an OverlayScope (a device preview) it stays in that box. A long press still runs `onCreate`.

### A section rail beside the menu

A large menu can show one section at a time: a rail (ActivityBar) picks the section, `visibleGroups` lists its
categories. On a phone the rail becomes the bottom bar and opens the menu as a bottom sheet.

```tsx
<ActivityBar items={sections} value={$section} onChange={(id) => { $section = id; if (narrow()) $sheet = true }} showLabels tooltips={false} collapsible={false} />
<NavSidebar items={items} title={() => current().label} visibleGroups={() => current().groups} search={false}
  itemSize="lg" subOverflow="marquee" resizable minWidth={220} maxWidth={460}
  sheetSide="bottom" menuButton={false} open={() => $sheet} onOpenChange={(o) => $sheet = o} />
```

### Nested items

An item with `parent: "<id>"` is listed indented under that item, in a fold of its own with a chevron at the end of the
parent row. The fold opens by itself while the parent or one of its children is the current page; the chevron (or → / ←
on the focused row) opens and closes it, and the choice is remembered. The group count counts top-level items.

```ts
{ id: "/editors", label: "Editörler", href: "/editors", group: "Formlar" },
{ id: "/editors/terminal", label: "Terminal", href: "/editors/terminal", group: "Formlar", parent: "/editors" },
```

composite/rich-text-editor.a11y:
The writing area is `role="textbox"` with `aria-multiline`, `aria-placeholder`, `aria-readonly` and the field's label
and description. The toolbar is a `role="toolbar"` with one tab stop (← → Home End move, mirrored in RTL); buttons
announce their state with `aria-pressed` and their shortcut with `aria-keyshortcuts`, and never take the selection
away on click. Suggestions are a `listbox` driven from the text (`aria-activedescendant`, ↑ ↓ Enter Tab Esc). The
link panel is a labelled dialog; invalid addresses are flagged (`aria-invalid`) and only http(s), mailto, tel and
relative links are accepted.

composite/wizard.notes:
`steps`, `layout`, `cols` and `color` are live: pass a getter (or a signal-backed value in JSX) and the wizard follows it.
A new `steps` list builds the form again from the first step, keeping the values typed so far.


```tsx
<Wizard steps={steps} stepper={false} count={false}
  labels={{ back: "Previous", next: <>Continue <Icon of={arrowRight} /></>, count: (i, n) => `${i + 1} / ${n}` }} />
```
composite/wizard.a11y:
A `form` with `novalidate` (messages come from the schema); `aria-busy` while submitting. The stage list marks the
current stage with `aria-current="step"`; moving to a stage focuses its heading, so screen readers announce it. The
Progress bar carries "Step 2 of 3" as its label, and step-level errors are `role="alert"`.
